title: Threadline: a thread that bends only so many times
why_hot: Listed in a 2026 roundup of 34 free browser games with a one-line pitch that reads like a mechanic, not a genre. The constraint (limited bends) is legible before the first click.

audience: Puzzle and tension players who like minimal one-screen browser games

title: Sonar: see with sound, but the dark listens back
why_hot: Recent no-build single-file browser game with a clean hook: every ping reveals the cave and also tells the predators exactly where you are. Novel risk-perception mechanic, 40 KB, zero dependencies.
